WATCH: The Philippine Air Force (PAF) deployed an S-70i Black Hawk helicopter to support aerial firefighting operations over Homonhon Island in Guiuan, Eastern Samar, as efforts intensify to contain a spreading grass and forest fire, its high ranking official said Monday.

PAF Spokesperson Col. Ma. Christina Basco said operating in terrain difficult to access by ground responders, the aircraft was equipped with a helibucket system to conduct precision water drops over affected areas. 

As of latest reports, the helicopter has completed nine sorties, significantly aiding suppression efforts. │via Rex Espiritu
